title: Airboat Rides Melbourne

services.name: Airboat Tours
services.desc: Feel the thrill as you skim across the St. Johns River on an exciting airboat ride in Melbourne, Florida, surrounded by the sights and sounds of the Space Coast wetlands. Our Melbourne FL airboat tours offer the perfect mix of high-speed adventure and natural beauty, with time to slow down and take in the scenery, wildlife, and sweeping marsh views. During the tour, you might spot alligators sunning on the banks, turtles tucked along the shoreline, ospreys diving for fish, or bald eagles soaring overhead. services.name: Wildlife tour
services.desc: Our most popular tour! Take your airboat adventure a step further with our Educational & Informative Eco Tour. This 1-hour tour offers everything you love about the thrill of an airboat ride, plus a deeper look into the wildlife, ecosystems, and natural beauty of the St. Johns River. With a 6-passenger minimum (Don’t have 6 in your group? Not a problem, we can usually pair you up with others!) , this pay-per-person tour is perfect for anyone curious about Florida’s wetlands and the animals that call it home. Our experienced captains share fascinating insights along the way, making it fun, exciting, and educational for all ages. We depart from Lake Washington Park and Three Forks Marsh
